identity.title: List of Pokémon Sun & Moon volumes

leadText: The of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by VIZ Media in , which began in May 2018. Much like with the , the chapters from the original mini-volume releases in Japan of the Sun & Moon arc are collected in two separate smaller mini-volume releases for the VIZ release in North America with three to four chapters each. Once the Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire arc ends in the regular volumes, the Sun & Moon arc will be properly collected in that format as well. The series concluded when the twelfth and final volume was published on January 11, 2022.
